## Description

Implements the market-research activity (S1): sourcing, freshness checking and provenance recording of the market series that feed proxy-chain and market-sizing work. Does not estimate demand (systematic-market-sizing) or calibrate chains (proxy-industry-chain). Use when: "market data", "data pipeline", "data freshness", "series provenance".
